written.headline: Nvidia adds four open-weight Cosmos 3 Nano checkpoints for interactive simulation
written.summary: Nvidia released four open-weight checkpoints—Cosmos3-Nano-Transfer-Auto, Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Auto, Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Transfer and Cosmos3-Nano-Sim-Bimanual—each built on the 16-billion-parameter Cosmos 3 Nano model. They generate interactive world simulations and multi-sensor driving scenes.
